purpose: Read-only diagnosis of where independent-run normalizer scatter becomes visible; no sampler, target, geometry, or model changes.

window_definition: cov(window_logZ_increment, final_logZ)/var(final_logZ); sums to1, may be negative, includes cross-window covariance; not causal variance contribution.
findings: Bright v5 logZ scatter is small through beta=.25 (SD .03669), rises to .13844 at beta=.49438, and reaches 1.29227 at beta=1. The final window accounts for .95792 of Cov(window increment, final logZ)/Var(final logZ). Baseline v1 has the same late pattern (.91914), with only four replicas.

The hypothesis that large measured cumulative-normalizer scatter is already established by beta=.1 is contradicted in these runs (v5 SD .05022, normalizer run-weight ESS 7.983/8). This does not rule out initial mode-coverage errors whose importance appears only at colder targets.

For v5 bright beta>.49438, physical moves accept 56.01% and SED moves 40.43%, while only 5/77824 independence proposals accept (.006425%) and 28/77824 exchange proposals accept (.03598%). Physical acceptance at beta=1 is still 32.26%; high local acceptance alone does not establish substantial movement or mode exploration.

Genealogical ESS drops from mean15.11 at beta=.49438 to2.040 at beta=1, despite mean final pre-resampling weight ESS249.4/256. Accepted independence proposals can change coordinates while retaining genealogy labels, so these labels do not prove dependence on initial q0 draws.

Bright v5 final normalizer run-weight ESS is2.884/8 and one run contributes55.52% of estimated normalizer mass. Estimated relative MCSE of the mean normalizer is50.34%; eight runs do not establish a reliable reference normalizer.

One v5 run (seed2026102172, logZ1.1595) retains a broad physical/phase cloud: m_r SD.5442, radius mean4.382/SD1.946, phase resultant.8521. Other runs have m_r SD.04388–.07239, radius means3.446–3.562, and phase resultants.9792–.9998. This is a descriptive population discrepancy, not proof of the correct mode.

Redshift and SED run means are comparatively stable relative to within-run dispersion: v5 redshift between-mean SD / RMS within SD .1188; SED fractions .0702–.1173. Sersic-logit mean has exploratory Pearson correlation-.7661 with logZ (leave-one-out range-.8611 to-.5449). All tested coordinate associations are retained; none identify a cause.

The single frozen higher-effort V100 run has bright logZ3.8680, final genealogical ESS4.663/1024, final physical acceptance29.46%, and zero final independence acceptance. One run cannot estimate between-run variation or verify convergence.
assessment: The evidence localizes the visible failure to the late bridge and shows that accepted local moves coexist with population disagreement and effectively absent global refreshes. It weakens an explanation based solely on immediate q0 rejection/weight collapse. It cannot distinguish inherited missing modes from insufficient late invariant exploration, because intermediate coordinates and move distances were not saved and early selection can affect later increments.

controlled_next_test.status: Proposed only; no sampler changes or GPU jobs submitted.
controlled_next_test.hypothesis: More invariant mutation at fixed late bridge temperatures reduces bright late-increment dispersion while leaving q0, target and geometry fixed.
controlled_next_test.design: Keep the existing four-observation likelihood grouping, N256, T64, q0, model artifacts, and frozen gradient geometry. For four fresh independent prefixes, checkpoint after stage45 at beta=.494384765625. Fork each checkpoint into two independent continuation seeds per arm: baseline M32 versus M128 for stages46–64. In the M128 arm also apply96 extra invariant moves at the checkpoint before the first new reweighting. All schedules and moves are fixed before running. This is16 short tails from4 independent prefixes, not16 independent complete populations.
measurements: Preserve logZ at the fork and each late logZ increment.
Compare within-prefix continuation variance and across-prefix arm means of late logZ increments; treat prefixes as the independent units.
Compare final physical/phase and score summaries with normalizer weighting; retain all normalizer estimates, including extinct populations.
Save checkpoints and accepted squared jump distances by block; acceptance fraction alone is inadequate.
Report actual likelihood-call cost and wall time; no efficiency claim from variance alone.
controlled_next_test.falsification: A consistent reduction in late dispersion with unchanged prefix supports inadequate late mutation effort. Persistent prefix-dependent outcomes despite added moves leaves inherited mode loss or an ineffective local move family plausible. Four prefixes give a small mechanism test, not a convergence or efficiency acceptance result.
